title: Same Model, Different Harness: Different Coding-Agent Results
title_zh: 同一模型，不同 Harness：不同的 Coding-Agent 结果
abstract_en: A coding agent combines a model with a harness, which decides what the model sees, which tools it can use, and how the work continues. We ask whether changing the harness changes the result when the model and task stay fixed. We compare two configurations of the same harness on three coding benchmarks. The control supplies the full conversation in time order, while the treatment keeps the same record but mechanically shortens older tool results as the context fills and responds to repeated or stalled work. Under tight context, the treatment raises mean per-task fail-to-pass fraction (F2PF) in all three pressure comparisons and increases complete solutions on SWE-bench Verified and SWE-bench Pro. The tight-window Verified comparison uses 169 tasks, a 20,480-token window, and a fixed 480-second attempt endpoint; on this cohort, treatment raises mean per-task F2PF from 28 percent to 49 percent and complete solutions from 43 to 72. Without model-specific retuning, the same frozen treatment also raises both endpoints on the same cohort for three additional models with different designs. In the wide-window Qwen3.6 comparisons, observed arm outcomes are close on Verified and Pro, while FeatureBench retains a higher mean per-task F2PF under treatment. On the wide-window Verified cohort, treatment also serves fewer prompt tokens per turn. Because changing the harness changed what unchanged model weights could accomplish, coding-agent evaluations should treat the model and harness together as the tested solver.
abstract_zh: Coding agent 由模型与 harness 共同构成，harness 决定模型可见的信息、可用工具以及任务如何持续推进。本文研究：在模型和任务保持不变时，仅改变 harness 是否会改变结果。作者在三个 coding benchmark 上比较同一 harness 的两种配置：control 按时间顺序提供完整对话；treatment 保留相同记录，但随着上下文填满，机械地压缩较早的工具结果，并对重复或停滞的工作作出响应。在紧张的上下文窗口条件下，treatment 在三组压力比较中均提高了平均单任务 fail-to-pass fraction（F2PF），并在 SWE-bench Verified 和 SWE-bench Pro 上增加了完整解决方案数量。以紧窗口的 SWE-bench Verified 比较为例，队列包含 169 个任务，窗口为 20,480 tokens，单次尝试固定在 480 秒结束；treatment 将平均单任务 F2PF 从 28% 提高到 49%，完整解决方案从 43 个提高到 72 个。在不针对模型进行重新调参的情况下，同一个冻结的 treatment 对三个架构设计不同的额外模型，在该队列上也同时提高了这两个指标。在宽窗口的 Qwen3.6 比较中，Verified 和 Pro 的两组结果接近，但 FeatureBench 在 treatment 下仍保持更高的平均单任务 F2PF；在宽窗口 Verified 队列中，treatment 每轮提供的 prompt tokens 也更少。研究表明，改变 harness 会改变相同模型权重能够完成的任务，因此 coding-agent 评测应将模型与 harness 视为一个整体求解器，而不应只评估模型本身。
key_points_zh: 仅改变 harness、保持模型和任务不变，也会显著改变 coding-agent 的完成率与 F2PF。
紧上下文条件下，treatment 在三组压力比较中均改善结果；SWE-bench Verified 完整解从 43 个增至 72 个。
同一冻结的 harness 改进可迁移到三个架构不同的模型，无需针对模型重新调参。
宽上下文下，Verified 和 Pro 的差异较小，但 FeatureBench 仍显示 treatment 的 F2PF 更高。
Coding-agent benchmark 应把模型和 harness 作为整体进行评测。

llm_assessment.comment: This provides compelling evidence that coding-agent evaluations must treat harness behavior, context management, and model weights as a coupled system.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该研究有力表明，Coding-Agent评测必须将Harness行为、上下文管理和模型参数视为耦合系统。
